title: Concrete Godement multiplication and codegeneracies
statement: For a scheme $X$ and an $\mathcal O_X$-module $F$, write $T(F)$ for the product of stalk skyscrapers from [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model]. Define $m_F:T(T(F))\to T(F)$ by projecting to the outer skyscraper at $x$, evaluating its stalk, then taking the stalk of the projection $T(F)\to\operatorname{sky}_x(F_x)$ and evaluating at $x$. Define $s_i:T^{n+2}(F)\to T^{n+1}(F)$ by inserting $m$ in position $i$: $s_0=m_{T^n(F)}$ and $s_{i+1}=T(s_i)$ recursively. A cosimplicial object $A$ satisfies ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies when there are equalities $A^n=T^{n+1}(F)$ under which every codegeneracy $A^{n+1}\to A^n$ equals this insertion. All maps are actual product/skyscraper constructions; no chosen existence witness is used.
